utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you mean the repair drive? I heard folks are still signing up this afternoon, so it’s worth swinging by before it wraps up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure there’s still time to sign up this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, pretty sure there’s still time this afternoon, but I’d head over sooner rather than later.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m on it. I’ll tell the others and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, just make sure you don’t leave me out of the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep you posted and make sure the others hear about it too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look at the repair drive now. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — I can take a look. Tell me what’s acting up on the drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What’s the symptom - no spin, noise, or it’s not reading the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I need a few hands and some tools. Can you bring tape, a wrench, and a box of nails?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can bring those. I'll grab the tape, wrench, and a box of nails on my way over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that after I check the school schedule and see when we can fit the repair drive in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Faye. I can line up the rest once you know the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll check the school schedule and then we can line up the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: what’s the first step, and when do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Start at the front door and I’ll meet you there around 10 a.m. If that changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it. Come by the repair drive after lunch, and I’ll make sure you know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: After lunch works, but can you tell me where to park and whether I need to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Park along the street by the community center, and no need to bring anything - we’ve got the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m still catching up on the details. Is there anything I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just bring yourself, and if you have any old tools, spare screws, or a toolbox, those are welcome too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I can bring my toolbox and a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what’s included in the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It includes the basic repairs list we talked about: small fixes, patching, and help with things like loose hinges or minor leaks. If you need, I can go over the full list again before you say yes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I just wanted to confirm the full list before I agree.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive, but I need to keep it light today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can take a look and keep it quick.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, I’ll keep it brief.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a drill and a pry bar if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, can you bring any screws or wood glue too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I can bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help with the repair drive, but I need the exact location first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Which address is it again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s 1423 Maple Street. I’ve got the driveway flagged for the repair team.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can bring my drill and a few spare screws. Tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Start with the loose porch rail by the front steps, then we’ll work inward.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, I’ll start there and bring the drill over now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little concerned about whether we have enough time and the right supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we know exactly what we’re short on, or are we still guessing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re still guessing a bit, but I think the first step is to inventory what we already have and list the missing supplies so we can stop losing time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that—what kind of repair items do you still need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I still need basics like light bulbs, faucet washers, and a few hand tools if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can bring over some light bulbs and faucet washers, and I may have a couple hand tools you can borrow too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over the spare cords and a box of screws if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d help a lot, thanks. I can come by a little later and help sort through the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set those aside so they’re ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re organizing the repair drive this afternoon. I can swing by and let you know who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, thanks. I need to work around pickup, so a quick update would help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, I’ll swing back with a quick update once I hear who’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need from me about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’d like you to help by checking in with a few neighbors and letting me know who can lend a hand this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely, I’ll check with a few neighbors and let you know who can help this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. What part of the repair drive needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just the drive itself. I need to check the belt and clean out the contacts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I can take a look at the belt and clean the contacts with you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone I can think of, and I can swing by with coffee if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s kind of you. I heard about the repair drive, and I can come by too if you need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Nell. I’ll spread the word and we can use all the hands we can get.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I know the repair drive starts by the old post office. I can walk you there if you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, it’s just a short walk from the old post office. I can take you there now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive already start, or are you still putting it together?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still putting it together, so it hasn’t started yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. When are you planning to start it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's moving along, but I still need the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, it’s moving, though I keep mixing up which crew is doing what. I’ll get you the details straight in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, just tell me which crew and I’ll keep it straight.
